pt.edible: Not edible. Leaves and berries are mildly toxic.

pt.culturalUses: A symbol of fidelity woven into wedding garlands; evergreen decoration in midwinter festivals.
pt.description: A woody evergreen climber with lobed juvenile leaves and unlobed adult leaves on flowering shoots; globular clusters of green-yellow flowers in autumn and black berries in spring.

es.culturalUses: El 'árbol de mayo' del folclore inglés; la planta clásica de los setos de las tierras de cultivo cercadas.
